rules.sha256: case: sha256 of the canonical JSON of the case definition (same as agenda-practice-lib.ts scenarioDefinitionSha256 / passk.json `definition`); file: approved file sha256 from the holdout registry
rules.turns: messages sent to the real Luna and graded: transcript rows `say` and `answer:*` (agenda-core) or observed turns (Golden results.json)
rules.results_history: one row per run that graded the case: agenda-core passk.json (c/n as reported), legacy flat runs regraded with the frozen E map, Golden free-use results.json; never a sealed/validation run folder
rules.phenomena_basis: tag = author capability tag; template = {{d:..|format}} token; text = heuristic text rule; structure = fixture/oracle structure (homonym names, discard oracle, unsupported)
